sources.evidence: Upstream publishes this catalogue as an MIT-licensed public repository: its README describes the project as a community-editable library and its LICENSE grants use, copy, modification, and distribution of the project contents. Fortiq preserves every entry's attribution, original category/tags, and official Clash share link, and displays previews from the original public image URLs without copying or repackaging the image files. The Fortiq project owner reviewed and approved including this attributed source in the 2026-11-27 release.
